caption: This black and white drawing depicts a street scene with architectural and urban elements. There are two balconies with ornate railings on the first floor of a building, one closer to the left and the other to the right. Under these balconies, there are two distinct street lamps with decorative posts and lampshades, both placed on the sidewalk. Below the left balcony, there is a building facade with a striped awning extending outwards and partially covering a window or doorway underneath. The right side of the drawing shows part of a shop sign with partial, unclear writing and an awning above a doorway. The windows on the upper floor feature shutters, with one window being open. The composition is formed entirely with differing densities of black ink dots and shading, creating contrast and shadow to define objects, forms, and surfaces. The sidewalk, curb, and street are visible at the bottom of the drawing, and architectural details such as window frames, sills, and pane divisions can be seen within the composition. The background is left mostly blank, emphasizing the buildings and street elements.
title: Balcony Railing
